title: Etale and Zariski cohomology agree on schemes with strictly henselian local rings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme all of whose local rings $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ are strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and let $\mathcal F$ be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $\epsilon:X_{\Et}\to X_{\rm Zar}$ be the morphism of sites given by the inclusion functor $u:X_{\rm Zar}\to X_{\Et}$, $U\mapsto(U\hookrightarrow X)$, from the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites], [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with direct image $\epsilon_*\mathcal F$, $(\epsilon_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(U\hookrightarrow X)$, an abelian sheaf on $X_{\rm Zar}$, inverse image $\epsilon^{-1}$ and counit $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}:\epsilon^{-1}\epsilon_*\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ of $\epsilon^{-1}\dashv\epsilon_*$. For $q\ge0$ let the comparison map $c^q:H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)$ be the pullback $\epsilon^*:H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\epsilon^{-1}\epsilon_*\mathcal F)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback] (for the final object $X$ of $X_{\rm Zar}$, $u(X)=X$) followed by the map induced by $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}$ (Zariski cohomology [def-sc-zariski-cohomology], etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]); in degree $0$ it is the identity of $\mathcal F(X)$. Then $c^q$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$.

source.place: Lemma 09AX (label lemma-local-rings-strictly-henselian), line 14205: the comparison via the morphism of sites $\epsilon:X_{\acute{e}t}\to X_{\rm Zar}$, vanishing of higher direct images from strict henselian local schemes, and the Leray spectral sequence

proof.text: *The morphism of sites and the groups.* By [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites] the inclusion functor $u:X_{\rm Zar}\to X_{\Et}$ is continuous and defines a morphism of sites $\epsilon:X_{\Et}\to X_{\rm Zar}$, with $\epsilon_*\mathcal F=\mathcal F\circ u$; $X$ is a final object of $X_{\rm Zar}$ and $u(X)=\mathrm{id}_X$ is the final object of $X_{\Et}$. The group $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\mathcal G)$ of [def-sc-zariski-cohomology] is by definition $R^q$ of $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G(X)$ on $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$, i.e. the group $H^q(X,\mathcal G)$ over the object $X$ of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2). The group $H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)$ of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is computed from a K-injective resolution of $\mathcal F[0]$; an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ is one, since a bounded below complex of injectives is K-injective [lem-sp-kinjective-computes] (2), so $H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)=H^q(\Gamma(X,\mathcal I^\bullet))=H^q(u(X),\mathcal F)$ in the notation of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2). Hence $c^q$ is the edge map $e^q_{X,\mathcal F}=H^q(u(X),\varepsilon_{\mathcal F})\circ\epsilon^*$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-leray-degenerate] for the morphism of sites $\epsilon$ and the object $V=X$ of $X_{\rm Zar}$, with $\epsilon^*$ the pullback of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback].

source.place: Lemma Tag 09AX (lemma-local-rings-strictly-henselian, line 14205), proof, first sentence: 'Let epsilon : S_etale -> S_Zar be the morphism of sites given by the inclusion functor'; the identification of the statement's H^i(S_Zar, F) with Zariski cohomology of epsilon_* F

proof.text: *Higher direct images as sheafified presheaves.* For $q\ge0$ let $\mathcal P^q$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\rm Zar}$ with $\mathcal P^q(U)=H^q(u(U),\mathcal F)=H^q(U,\mathcal F)$, the cohomology of $\mathcal F$ over the object $U\hookrightarrow X$ of $X_{\Et}$, with restrictions induced by those of an injective resolution of $\mathcal F$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf], applied to $\epsilon$ (given by $u$), $R^q\epsilon_*\mathcal F\cong(\mathcal P^q)^\#$, the Zariski sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]; in particular $R^q\epsilon_*\mathcal F=0$ as soon as $(\mathcal P^q)^\#=0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09AX, proof, second sentence: 'The Zariski sheaf R^p epsilon_* F is the sheaf associated to the presheaf U -> H^p_etale(U, F)' (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma Tag 072W, sites-cohomology.tex line 747)

proof.text: *Every class of positive degree is Zariski locally zero.* Let $q\ge1$, $U\subseteq X$ open, $\xi\in\mathcal P^q(U)=H^q(U,\mathcal F)$ and $x\in U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-local-ring-colimit] the class $\xi$ has an image in $H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_x^{-1}\mathcal F)$, $g_x:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to X$ the canonical morphism, and the induced map $\varinjlim_{W\ni x}H^q(W,\mathcal F)\to H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_x^{-1}\mathcal F)$ is an isomorphism. By hypothesis $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], so the target is $0$ by [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-etale-acyclic] ($q\ge1$). Hence the image of $\xi$ in the directed colimit is $0$, and by the last assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-local-ring-colimit] there is an open $W$ with $x\in W\subseteq U$ and $\xi|_W=0$ in $\mathcal P^q(W)$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09AX, proof, third and fourth sentences: the stalk at x is colim H^p_etale(U, F) = H^p_etale(Spec(O_{X,x}), G_x) (Lemma Tag 03Q6, line 7464) and these vanish by Lemma Tag 03QO (line 8207)

proof.text: *Vanishing of $R^q\epsilon_*\mathcal F$ for $q>0$.* Fix $q\ge1$ and consider the morphism of presheaves $\varphi:\mathcal P^q\to0$ to the zero presheaf on $X_{\rm Zar}$. It is locally surjective trivially (the only section $0$ is the image of $0$). It is locally injective: if $s,t\in\mathcal P^q(U)$, apply step 3 to $\xi=s-t$ at every $x\in U$; the opens $W_x$ obtained form a Zariski covering $\{W_x\subseteq U\}_{x\in U}$ with $s|_{W_x}=t|_{W_x}$ (restriction is additive). By [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective] $\varphi^\#:(\mathcal P^q)^\#\to0^\#$ is an isomorphism. The zero presheaf is a sheaf, so $0\to0^\#$ is an isomorphism (the identity $0\to0$ factors through it uniquely, [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]) and $0^\#=0$; thus $(\mathcal P^q)^\#=0$ and, by step 2, $R^q\epsilon_*\mathcal F=0$ for all $q>0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09AX, proof, fourth sentence: 'Thus the higher direct images of R^p epsilon_* F are zero' (read: the higher direct images R^p epsilon_* F, p > 0, are zero), the stalkwise vanishing being turned into the vanishing of the sheaf

proof.text: *Conclusion by the degenerate Leray spectral sequence.* By step 4, $R^q\epsilon_*\mathcal F=0$ for all $q>0$. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-site-leray-degenerate], applied to the morphism of sites $\epsilon$, the sheaf $\mathcal F$ and the object $V=X$ of $X_{\rm Zar}$, shows that the edge map $e^q_{X,\mathcal F}:H^q(X,\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(u(X),\mathcal F)$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$; by step 1 this is $c^q:H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)$. In degree $0$ it is the identity of $(\epsilon_*\mathcal F)(X)=\mathcal F(X)$, as recorded there.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks 09AX: (1) epsilon from the inclusion functor (new lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites, Sites 00X6) and identification of the comparison map with the Leray edge map; (2) R^q epsilon_* F = sheafified presheaf U -> H^q(U,F) (new lem-weil-pbc-site-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf, site version of 072W; the existing lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf is only the etale-to-etale case); (3) classes of positive degree are Zariski locally zero, by the colimit over neighbourhoods (new lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-local-ring-colimit, 03Q6/09YQ + 03F3) and vanishing over strictly henselian local rings (new lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-etale-acyclic, 03QO final assertion; the existing lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-sections-stalk is only Gamma = stalk); (4) hence the sheafification vanishes (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective, W_iff_isLocallyBijective), done locally rather than via stalks to avoid a stalk node; (5) degenerate Leray (new lem-weil-pbc-site-leray-degenerate, 0733(1); lemma-weil-pbc-leray-acyclicity is the abstract acyclic-resolution lemma and is left for that node's own split). Statement corrected: the clause 'with the canonical identification epsilon^{-1} epsilon_* F = F for this inclusion' is false for a general scheme (the counit is not an isomorphism, e.g. for a sheaf with sections only on non-trivial finite etale covers); the comparison map is now defined as the pullback followed by the counit; lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites added to stmt_deps since the statement presupposes that epsilon is a morphism of sites. Stacks typos noted: 'x in X' for 'x in S', 'higher direct images of R^p epsilon_* F' for 'the higher direct images R^p epsilon_* F'.

reviewed.note: STATEMENT CORRECTED: the former 'canonical identification epsilon^{-1} epsilon_* F = F' is false in general; the comparison map is now defined as pullback followed by the counit (identity in degree 0), which is what the citer gabber-criterion uses. 5 steps following Stacks 09AX: the morphism of sites (new unsplit 00X6 node) and the groups; R^q epsilon_* F as the sheafified presheaf (new unsplit 072W node for sites); positive-degree classes Zariski-locally zero via the colimit formula (new unsplit 03Q6/09YQ node) and the vanishing over strictly henselian local rings (new unsplit 03QO node); sheafification of a locally bijective map (new composed Mathlib leaf, LocallyBijective.lean:114/153 and Localization.lean:80 verified by L); degenerate Leray (new unsplit 0733 (1) node).
